name: The Rolling Stones

whyMatters.en: London blues-rock band that sustained riff-based hard rock and stagecraft from 1960s singles through Exile-era peak and decades of touring.
whyMatters.zh: 伦敦蓝调摇滚：从 1960 年代单曲经 Exile 时期高峰到数十年巡演，持续 riff 导向 hard rock 与舞台工艺。

note.zh: 1965 年 AM 电台上的 fuzz riff 武器。

note.en: Ensemble dread on Let It Bleed–era track.
note.zh: Let It Bleed 时期合奏紧迫感。

interviewQuotes.text: It's only rock 'n' roll but I like it.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Mick Jagger

interviewQuotes.text: The music is the most important thing.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Keith Richards

lyricQuotes: Rape, murder, it's just a shot away

shortBio.en: Jagger / Richards blues-rock; Satisfaction and Gimme Shelter are poles.
shortBio.zh: Jagger / Richards 蓝调摇滚；Satisfaction 与 Gimme Shelter 是两极。

body.en:
Formed 1962. Early R&B covers become original riff hits; late-60s/early-70s albums (Beggars Banquet, Let It Bleed, Sticky Fingers, Exile on Main St.) are the critical peak—Richards open-G riffs, Watts pocket, Jagger vocal persona.

(I Can’t Get No) Satisfaction (1965) and Gimme Shelter (1969) bookend fuzz-pop breakthrough and darker ensemble rock.
body.zh:
1962 年组建。早期 R&B 翻唱变为原创 riff 热单；60 末/70 初专辑（Beggars Banquet、Let It Bleed、Sticky Fingers、Exile on Main St.）是批评高峰——Richards 开放 G 调 riff、Watts 口袋感、Jagger 人声人设。

(I Can’t Get No) Satisfaction（1965）与 Gimme Shelter（1969）标记 fuzz 流行突破与更暗的合奏摇滚两端。

title.en: Riff longevity as a working band
title.zh: 作为工作乐队的 riff 长寿

body.en:
Stones matter as a long-running blues-rock economy: guitar riffs first, groove second, image third. Catalog density in 1968–72 still anchors the reputation.

Touring machine and songbook share credit.
body.zh:
Stones 要紧处是长运行的蓝调摇滚经济：吉他 riff 第一、groove 第二、形象第三。1968–72 目录密度仍锚定声誉。

巡演机器与歌本共享功劳。

title.en: Jones era, Taylor peak, Wood decades
title.zh: Jones 时期、Taylor 高峰、Wood 数十年

body.en:
Brian Jones early multi-instrument color; Mick Taylor on the late-60s/early-70s peak records; Ronnie Wood on the long touring era.

Watts’s death ends a rhythmic constant—versions matter.
body.zh:
Brian Jones 早期多乐器色彩；Mick Taylor 在 60 末/70 初峰值唱片；Ronnie Wood 在长巡演年代。

Watts 去世结束节奏常量——版本要紧。

title.en: Satisfaction: fuzz riff as pop weapon

body.en:
Gibson Maestro fuzz on the hook; Jagger’s lyric complaint; AM radio saturation in 1965.

Riff-first writing becomes a pop-rock default.
body.zh:
钩子上的 Gibson Maestro fuzz；Jagger 的抱怨歌词；1965 年 AM 电台饱和。

riff 优先写作成为流行摇滚默认。

body.en:
Richards riff, Merry Clayton guest vocal, Watts/Wyman lock—late-60s darkness without abandoning blues form.

Album-era band as cinema-adjacent rock.
body.zh:
Richards riff、Merry Clayton 客串人声、Watts/Wyman 锁定——不放弃蓝调形式的 60 年代末黑暗。

专辑时代乐队作为电影邻近摇滚。

body.en:
Jagger/Richards writing axis; Watts’s swing; bass and second guitar roles shift by era.

Chemistry is documented in takes, not vague metaphors.
body.zh:
Jagger/Richards 写作轴；Watts 的摇摆；贝斯与第二吉他角色随时代变。

化学作用记录在 take 里，不是空泛比喻。

title.en: Hard-rock and indie still borrow the strut
title.zh: Hard-rock 与 indie 仍借用其步态

body.en:
Open-G riffs and swagger vocal phrasing feed hard rock and later garage/indie revivalists.

Longevity itself becomes a reference type.
body.zh:
开放 G 调 riff 与趾高气扬的人声句式喂养 hard rock 与后来的车库/indie 复兴者。

长寿本身成为一种参照类型。

note.en: Long Watts-era rhythm constant across decades.
note.zh: 跨数十年的 Watts 时期节奏常量。
早期 riff 流行突破单曲。

note.en: Blues-rock riff economy sustained across decades.
note.zh: 跨数十年持续的蓝调摇滚 riff 经济。
